comparison.objective: Calibrate gripper force using a spring reference.
comparison.physical_skill: Apply controlled squeeze to a compliant reference and infer or set force calibration, rather than deliver discrete hammer impulses through a mandrel.
comparison.success_condition: A completed force calibration is stated and a full-score demo reported; target forces, calibration error, repeatability, and damage limits are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Force regulation is shared only generically; this tests measurement/calibration against a spring, not threshold fracture with retained-part and fragment outcomes.
